identifier.reasoning: This column identifies the specimen, not the insect taxon or location.

Fixed effects.reasoning: This column defines grouping variables, not a measurement of the organism.

Est..reasoning: Header names a measured trait (e.g., Shelter index), and cells contain the trait values.

SE.reasoning: Represents the Standard Error of the measurement.

Z-value.reasoning: Represents the Z-score used in the statistical test.

p value.reasoning: Represents the p-value from the statistical test.
